notes.title: Battle Support Game version 1.5 update
notes.content:
To change the game perspective:
Players can use the mouse to move the camera left and right to view the situation behind the battlefield, no longer a single fixed camera.
Enemy minions will appear from the far right of the map
time changed to 15 minutes

Purchase options:
Now the store has been updated with multiple purchase options
Standard, Deluxe and Ultimate.
and game bundles

New scene graph:

forest
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43722993/49a2e6190a8e9a39ce1dc338165b13d14c29c191.png[/img]

desert
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43722993/032c504f227009670cb4f8ac2ce6c3c4f5fa2d77.png[/img]

Added the background map of the area war:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43722993/e8a44b3caee03065915495cbd52de91146db1c47.jpg[/img]

Please stay tuned for more version updates

notes.title: Season 1 update content
notes.content:
Summer Season 1 update content:

• New mode:
regional warfare
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43722993/4023727ffdb2548745b6dfef3d25cdfbdddad791.png[/img]

• Task:
challenge task
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43722993/913a106850b9dc6010797ff89b2a5cfe2398a84f.png[/img]

• New scene graph:
beach
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43722993/048977ca34de5f6a35606a3466ddca2939113fe3.png[/img]

• New assets:
Material factory
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43722993/9d7b5ceecd47bf6cbc20a274130b33a65492068b.png[/img]

• New defenses:
barbed wire
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43722993/7907fee56589f4f8ef482686d79dc97d82463b9d.png[/img]
machine gun tower
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43722993/f80f744176d9b8d88aea94797d34d2590f21fe73.png[/img]

• New support cards:
sniper
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43722993/72c842542c9ff37fe837d79929262439afa4053a.png[/img]
armored car
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43722993/c50627e03e1f4bee9f6ec89b1bb0b529d57486bf.png[/img]
mechanical dog
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43722993/08b67a6f56eb4532f012f8ad156279454392939c.png[/img]

• New Pass:
season 1
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43722993/71ba73ce9c4be9bb43cff49c4b0c230582480247.png[/img]

• New parts:
Mythic parts can only be obtained through regional battles
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43722993/896a18b182cbabf7712954fe727f07a3c7c33936.jpg[/img]

• New rank system:
23 different military ranks

• Store additions:
Asset purchase interface
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43722993/3cec58a77184af482b692479c8598a42277cf3e1.png[/img]
Defense Purchase Interface
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43722993/d4486586d29230a1df4940c9253ffa2ca259b1e3.png[/img]

• New additions to the Armory:
Upgrade project interface
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43722993/566f718dd3e9dd51e5c69566f2593a89c351f93c.png[/img]

• Support card upgrade changes:
Changed from 4 levels in the old version to 15 levels, now each support card level is divided into 5 common levels, 4 rare levels, 3 epic levels, 2 legendary levels and 1 final level mythical level.

Thank you for your support, I wish you a happy summer and we are also preparing for the next update.
